title: Oracle Morning Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin surges 2.1 percent to seventy-nine thousand one hundred seventy-five dollars, locking in greed territory at seventy-four on the Fear and Greed index. Overnight gains held firm through the Asia session with no major pullback.

Hashrate sits at eight hundred eighty point three exahashes, underscoring steady miner commitment. The mempool holds eighty-two thousand five hundred seventy-three transactions with fees as low as two satoshis per byte, keeping the network efficient at block height
